review.notes: "over" correctly stays the surface preposition-named oblique rather than being folded into During (which renders only during/while/throughout), the indefinite "a long burn" is a dependent existential Skolemized on $x, "long" stays an unfused descriptive property on the witness, and the intransitive change-of-state subject takes Patient. No unstated wick-burn relation is invented.
